info.title: McpTime.Host
info.description: MCP server (stdio) with two read-only tools: current time in an IANA timezone and time conversion between timezones.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: MCP server (stdio) with two read-only tools: get_current_time returns the current time in an IANA time zone, convert_time converts a local time between two time zones.

options.name: --local-timezone
options.description: IANA time zone name used as the default for the tools, for example Europe/Vienna. Default: the system time zone, otherwise UTC.
